proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem orthogonalProjection_apply_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E) :
    K.orthogonalProjection x =
      K.linearProjOfIsCompl _ Submodule.isCompl_orthogonal_of_hasOrthogonalProjection x := by
  have : IsCompl K Kᗮ := Submodule.isCompl_orthogonal_of_hasOrthogonalProjection
  conv_lhs => rw [← IsCompl.projection_add_projection_eq_self this x]
  simp_rw [IsCompl.projection_apply]
  rw [map_add, orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_eq_self,
    orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_orthogonalComplement_eq_zero (Submodule.coe_mem _), add_zero]

candidates.requested_change: Generalize the statement of `Submodule.orthogonalProjection_apply_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl` by adding implicit binders `{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E}` (keeping `[K.HasOrthogonalProjection]`), leaving the proof the same.

candidates.claim: `Submodule.coe_orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl` is currently tied to section variables; it can be generalized to implicit `{E}` and `{K}` with the same typeclass assumptions, and the proof remains identical.
candidates.concern_label: Lemma can be stated with implicit `{E} {K}` binders (same assumptions)

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem coe_orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
    (K.orthogonalProjection : E →ₗ[𝕜] K) =
      K.linearProjOfIsCompl _ Submodule.isCompl_orthogonal_of_hasOrthogonalProjection :=
  LinearMap.ext <| orthogonalProjection_apply_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl

candidates.requested_change: Generalize the statement of `Submodule.coe_orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl` by adding implicit binders `{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E}` (keeping `[K.HasOrthogonalProjection]`), keeping the existing proof.

candidates.claim: `Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection` can be generalized from section variables to implicit `{E}` and `{K}` with the same assumptions; the `simp` proof works unchanged.
candidates.concern_label: Lemma can be stated with implicit `{E} {K}` binders (same assumptions)

open Submodule in
theorem coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
    K.starProjection.toLinearMap = K.isCompl_orthogonal_of_hasOrthogonalProjection.projection := by
  simp [starProjection, coe_orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl, IsCompl.projection]
